name: pulse-sip-daemon
description: Headless SIP user agent for Pulse Dialer: UDP SIP, digest auth, SDP, RTP with G.711 and RFC 2833 DTMF, driven by JSON lines on stdin/stdout.
//runtime: No dependencies. Node 18+ is the whole runtime — SIP, SDP, digest, RTP and the G.711 codecs are implemented under lib/, which is why there is nothing to compile and one artefact runs on Apple Silicon, Intel and Linux alike. Audio comes from an optional native addon (desktop/native) or optional PortAudio: `npm i portaudio` here if you would rather not build the addon.
